title: juglans regia f. laciniata
intro: Juglans regia f. laciniata, commonly known as the laciniated English walnut, is a variant of the English walnut tree (Juglans regia). This plant is known for its edible nuts and has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits. The laciniated English walnut is rich in antioxidants, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which provide various health benefits, including protection against cardiovascular disease, neurodegenerative disorders, and certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of Juglans regia f. laciniata include juglone, a lignan that has been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-proliferative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
